items.text: -Act 3 boss check barrier fix.
-Fixed all enemies AI wherin special cases they would crash the game due to the player dissapearing. Unfied change on all enemies.
-Quick bugfix of the vehicles regarding map blockers like acid pools.
Not gonna list out the various small bugfixes I had in the last week, updating almost daily, they were too minor to mention.

--- Boss Rush added. The mode can only be accessed if you have the final boss achivement, or have a clear file (Read on). Once unlocked any save file cna be used to access it, the bosses can be defeated in any order, death leads to full booting to main menu... no second tries.
Each boss will drop 1 vitae injection to help you cope.

You can attempt the boss rush using a clear save file... this will let you try your skill at level 1, no weapon upgrade, no injection upgrades, no pet levels, no relics... good luck.: --- Final boss now generates clear save file used for future additions, achivement checks are also used in case you defeated the final boss prior to this update.: --- Final boss arena changed.: --- Acid status should now work as intended.: --- Two new achivements added regarding Boss Rush mode.: //// Important update ////: As you cna see, support for the game did not stop! However I began the painfull process of updating Shrouded in Sanity, preparing it for a console port. All updates WILL first come to Steam, in the form of free updates. Sorry for the delay, if you want to know more just join our Discord.

As always, we strongly recommend that you join our Discord server if you want to be completely up-to-date, or just want to hang out. We are extremely active on there, posting updates and screenshots most days. And if you're worried about spoilers, we have dedicated rooms for those, so they're easy to avoid. It's also super convenient for us to receive bug reports since you can post images, but it's also a direct way to give us suggestions and other comments.
Alternatively, if you don't use Discord, please consider joining our developer page here on Steam to get the latest news and updates, discuss any Pugware game, or report issues:

1.0 Update.
--- Final boss added, still work in progress balance and attacks wise, subject to change.
--- Ending added.
--- Credits added.
--- After credits added.
--- 3 new pieces of music added for the appropriate places.
--- Relic usage bug fixed where bow would be visible for no good reason.

Planned release date is still 4th of March, day after tomorrow, I still need to clean a lot of things up, and finish a trailer and an uncut gameplay video for the page as well as provide new up to date screenshots. Finally, achievements WILL be in on launch with more created as more content is added.
I am not some publisher who will make you a fancy roadmap, but here is some general outlines for what's planned:
-New game plus.
-Boss rush/Boss all at once (returning from SiS)
-More vehicles, including something... something... hover board...
-The pug hunt.
-Difficulty modes (need feedback to balance these out).
-At least one more area for the big secret.
-More pets.
-And some challenge modes, like Pacifist, No leveling, No healing, and permadeath mode, returning from Usurper.... for "fun".
